limits: Offline evidence consistency and arithmetic checks; no SSH/GPU/runtime verification or mutation performed.
Official output is a sequential capture-period comparison on structured C1/exact400, not causal attribution or general serving-capacity/quality qualification.

Historical stock and final captures share exact request bytes/output fingerprints but differ in serving settings and collection time; use the matched final control for the official settings comparison.
Grill compares achieved dispatch-to-settlement completion throughput, including TTFT; warmups are retained and excluded from measured medians.
Zero reported prefix-cache counts do not establish universally cold state.
Full token arrays are present in qualification rows but absent from stock Grill responses; reported12hex token digest equality is not a full-array capture.
Native evidence fingerprint chains, plan/reservation/request/response hashes, coverage and metric arithmetic were independently reconstructed; this does not attest original execution.

official_compare.assumptions: Model-based interval assumes stable, independent acquisition-level variation and an adequate log-scale mean model. Resetting a client does not prove independence. Positive autocorrelation can make the interval narrower than justified, increasing false directional conclusions. Sequential captures cannot remove time or carryover confounding; no causal attribution, equivalence, noninferiority, or guaranteed precision/power is established.
official_compare.scope: One short synthetic structured C1/exact400 workload; not general concurrency, long-context, model quality, tail SLOs, or full serving qualification. Deployment values are operator declarations, not server attestation. A settings fingerprint cannot prove only one internal knob changed.
